title: A Responsible Artificial Intelligence Framework for Groundwater Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.15657v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid development and widespread application of artificial intelligence (AI) have sparked intense discussions on how to deploy responsible AI systems in a manner aligned with human values and ethical standards. Compared to fields like healthcare, energy, or finance, the application of AI in groundwater is relatively limited, and research on responsible AI is even more scarce. Taking the middle reaches of the Heihe River Basin as the study area, this paper proposes six Responsible AI principles: transparency, technical robustness, privacy governance, fairness, accountability, and sustainability. LSTM and Transformer time-series models are developed using multi-source hydrometeorological data, and validated via post-hoc interpretability, Monte Carlo simulation, and scenario analysis. The results show that Transformer outperforms LSTM in accuracy, robustness, and interpretability, demonstrating the operability and practical value of Res

translated_title: 一种负责任的人工智能框架用于地下水建模
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15657v1 公告类型：新 摘要：人工智能（AI）的快速发展和广泛应用引发了关于如何以符合人类价值观和伦理标准的方式部署负责任AI系统的激烈讨论。与医疗、能源或金融等领域相比，AI在地下水领域的应用相对有限，而关于负责任AI的研究则更为稀缺。本文以黑河流域中游为研究区域，提出了六项负责任AI原则：透明度、技术鲁棒性、隐私治理、公平性、问责制和可持续性。利用多源水文气象数据开发了LSTM和Transformer时间序列模型，并通过事后可解释性、蒙特卡洛模拟和情景分析进行验证。结果表明，Transformer在准确性、鲁棒性和可解释性方面优于LSTM，展示了Res（负责任AI框架）的可操作性和实用价值。
tldr: 本文提出了一种包含六项原则的负责任AI框架，并验证了Transformer模型在地下水建模中优于LSTM，展示了该框架在实际应用中的可行性和价值。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a responsible AI framework with six principles and demonstrates that Transformer outperforms LSTM in groundwater modeling, showcasing the framework's operability and practical value.
